title: Resistors, capacitors, inductors and batteries
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: Every radio is built from a few simple parts. Each part does one job.
lines.label: the parts

lines.caption: A resistor opposes the flow of current.
lines.label: resistor

lines.caption: A potentiometer is a resistor you adjust with a knob, like a volume control.
lines.label: potentiometer

lines.caption: A capacitor is two plates with an insulator between them. It stores energy in an electric field.
lines.label: capacitor

lines.caption: An inductor is a coil of wire. It stores energy in a magnetic field.
lines.label: inductor

lines.caption: Switches open, close or redirect a circuit, and batteries supply the power. You will meet both in the cards.
lines.label: switch
